about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Saint John, Apostle and Evangelist” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Refreshed with heavenly food and drink, we humbly pray You, our God, that we also may be helped by his prayers in memory of whom we have partaken of these gifts. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
